findings.passage: I believe elections should be decided by Election Day.
findings.note: His answer, voting yes, in a candidate Q&A on eliminating the mail ballot grace period. The same answer also says: "We are one of only a few states that allow the delay and rarely does it have an impact on the outcome." Outlet: The Beacon (page updated 2024-10-11).

findings.passage: Kansas has some of the most secure elections in the nation.
findings.note: Start of his questionnaire answer on election integrity in Kansas (KSN, 2022, House District 74). He goes on: "While there is still some work to do to ensure ballot harvesting does not occur," "Kansans should be proud of the work done to ensure their vote counts." "I think other states aren't as secure and have work to do." "I think the US Government should stay out of the state election process." The page has nothing on ID or citizenship.
